# Feature: Secret wall — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #59 (Secret wall) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: looks solid, walk straight through. Unique: a passable wall, hidden by appearance alone. Useful: optional shortcuts and secrets off the main route. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** looks solid, walk straight through.

**So that** optional shortcuts and secrets off the main route.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Secret wall for the first time in its teaching room (mech-59-secret-wall-room). Teaching moment: First room: a room whose last orb is behind a stretch of wall that the layout suggests is too thin, with a readable clue beside it. A player who treats every drawn wall as solid completes the room one orb short and must search the walls, which teaches that appearance and collision are not the same thing in this game. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Drawn exactly as a wall but with no collision
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The first time you walk through, its sprite fades so you know what you found
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It never hides a required exit without a readable clue nearby

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It never hides a required exit without a readable clue nearby
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Secret wall's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-59-secret-wall-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #59.
